title: GameCheckpointImage
responsibility: Generate and revise checkpoint image candidates; replace the confirmed reference only after explicit acceptance.

inputs.name: GameCheckpointImage.checkpoint
inputs.description: Selected checkpoint whose guidance, rules or saved image are being edited.

inputs.name: GameCheckpointImage.view
inputs.description: Active game view containing scene direction and executable checkpoints.

inputs.name: GameCheckpointImage.document
inputs.description: Complete authored game document supplying the checkpoint and view context.

inputs.name: GameCheckpointImage.projectId
inputs.description: Selected local project identity used to bind host reads and writes.

inputs.name: GameCheckpointImage.revision
inputs.description: Expected document hash used to reject stale image generation or saves.

inputs.name: GameCheckpointImage.commit
inputs.description: Optional immutable Git revision for reading historical image bytes.

inputs.name: GameCheckpointImage.readonly
inputs.description: Disable editing and generation for historical or otherwise immutable views.

inputs.name: GameCheckpointImage.bridge
inputs.description: Local desktop host operations for project creation, persistence and explicit image generation.

inputs.name: GameCheckpointImage.change
inputs.description: Callback publishing the edited checkpoint, view patch or graph node list to its owner.

inputs.name: GameCheckpointImage.accept
inputs.description: Adopt the chosen candidate image and guidance through the modal owner.

outputs.name: GameCheckpointImage
outputs.description: Generate and revise checkpoint image candidates; replace the confirmed reference only after explicit acceptance.
